title: Karbala shaam se phir karbobala hai zainab
body:
KARBALA SHAAM SE PHIR KARBO BALA HAI ZAINAB, TERE HISSE MEIN FAQT YEHI LIKHA HAI ZAINAB
EK MAJLIS KI BINA SHAAM MEIN JO DAALI THI, HAR TARAF MATAME SARWAR KI SADA HAI ZAINAB
CHADARE FATIMA ZEHRA MEIN YE ISLAM PALA, TERI CHADAR NE BHI KYA KAAM KIYA HAI ZAINAB
SAJDA-E-SHUKR JO BETON KE JANAZE PE KIYA, TERE IS SABR PE KAUNAIN FIDA HAI ZAINAB
<<DIVIDER>>
BHAI NE TERE LAHU DEKE BACHAYA ISKO, DEENE SARWAR KI TERE DAM SE BAQA HAI ZAINAB
KAATE HAIN ZAALIMON NE BAZO-E-ABBAS-E-ALI, AUR CHHINEE HAI LAEENAON NE RIDAYE ZAINAB
PUSHTE ZEHRA PE GIRAYA GAYA DAR SHOLON KA, PUSHTE AQDAS PE TERE ZULM SIWA HAI ZAINAB
MERE MAJAYE KO PAMAAL KIYA HAI AMMA, AB QAYAMAT TALAK US KO KAHAN PAYE ZAINAB
